Several interacting components (X'_L, umklapp kernels, resistivity formula) demand careful treatment and genuine understanding of the method, not just straightforward application of a standard library.
rationale.execution: The pipeline involves four stages: parameter definition, numerical evaluation of scattering rates and 2D integrals, resistivity computation, and distribution function computation. While the steps are sequential and use standard numerical libraries (NumPy/SciPy), the scattering computation is a substantial intermediate step that feeds the final artifacts; dependencies require careful ordering. Not as complex as massive multi-source orchestration, but beyond a single simple script.
